name: Agent
description: The assistant itself — who it is, how it speaks, and whose world it looks after.

attributes.name: character
attributes.description: What it's like: temperament, attitude, what it cares about.

attributes.name: speaking_style
attributes.description: How it talks — register, length, quirks.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: The person whose world this is and who the assistant answers to.

attributes.name: descriptions
attributes.description: How this one has been described, in whoever's words — several are normal, because people describe the same thing differently and each telling is worth keeping.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Loose ties to other things, for what no attribute or relation says: everything about the move, everyone from that conference.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Anything else it knows about itself.
